lines.text: If you just got quoted twenty thousand dollars or more for brand-new impact windows, you're paying two to three times more than you have to.
Here in South Florida, most window companies don't source their own windows.
They buy them from a manufacturer and add their own profit on top.
Then they hire an outside crew to install them, and that crew charges its own price too.
You end up paying extra twice.
At VistaGuard, we source our impact windows straight from the manufacturer, and our own crew installs them.
No broker in the middle, and no separate labor bill, because our installation is free.
Same hurricane rating, two to three times less than what you were just quoted.
We've been installing windows in your neighborhood all across South Florida for over thirty years, we're licensed and insured, and every job carries a lifetime warranty on our products and materials.
